key_facts: Aug 17 CHECK (T+1d; Exa Aug 15-17 The National/AP/IranIntl + local Aug 17 Arab News/AJ/ST/HT/CBS; HOLD UNCHANGED): No Gulf government has officially announced an indefinite trade embargo against Iran through Aug 17. The 60-day June 17 US-Iran MoU expired Sun/Mon Aug 16-17 with neither side extending and Hormuz traffic collapsing to 3 vessels Sunday (520 vessels backlogged). Oman is finalizing a Hormuz transit route deal with Iran (provoking Trump threat to bomb Oman on Aug 17), effectively eliminating Oman (~0.005). UAE remains clear frontrunner: IranIntl (Aug 15) confirms UAE (Iran's #2 trading partner, ~7B pre-war) has largely halted trade after 4 ADNOC vessels were struck (Aug 8-14) and UAE's Aug 12 informal port ban on Iranian dhows/cargo ships; turning this de facto halt into a formal indefinite trade embargo right after MoU expiry is the primary scenario. Bahrain backed UAE measures (Aug 13), Kuwait holds 4 IRGC-linked Iranians, Saudi ships were targeted by Houthis off Mocha (Aug 17), and Qatar/Iran are clashing over 3 missing Iranian pilots (Aug 17).
